Name: Custom Critters
Author: spacechase0
Description:
[b]Custom Critters[/b] lets content packs add custom critters to the world.

[b][size=5]Install[/size][/b]
[list=1]
[*]Install the latest version of [url=https://smapi.io]SMAPI[/url].
[*]Unzip the mod folder into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]
[b][size=5]Use[/size][/b]
[list]
[*][b]For players:[/b] just install the mod and it'll work automatically for content packs that use it (see [i]Dependencies[/i] > [i]Mods requiring this file[/i] above).
[*][b]For mod authors:[/b] see [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1259]example content pack[/url].
[/list]
[b][size=5]Compatibility[/size][/b]
Compatible with Stardew Valley 1.5.5+ on Linux/macOS/Windows, both single-player and multiplayer.

[b][size=5]See also[/size][/b]
[list]
[*][url=https://github.com/spacechase0/StardewValleyMods/blob/develop/CustomCritters/docs/release-notes.md#release-notes]Release notes[/url]
[*][url=https://github.com/spacechase0/StardewValleyMods]Source code[/url]
[/list]
